visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a pink-haired girl with two large buns entering a room. She wears a white shirt with a character on it, pink socks, and carries a light blue bag. She looks tired with a flat, uninterested facial expression. A yellow character is seated on a blue sofa in the background, staring at a handheld gaming console. (2) The yellow character looks up and waves his hand enthusiastically while still holding the game. The girl stares at him blankly. (3) A large red 'X' graphic appears over the screen with bold text. (4) The scene repeats: the pink-haired girl enters the room again through the same door with a tired expression. (5) This time, the yellow character immediately jumps from the sofa. He uses his hands to help the girl onto the sofa. He reaches behind her back and unclips a pink bra from under her shirt, throwing it aside. (6) He brings her a cup of bubble tea and then a glass of yellow juice. He spreads a large yellow patterned blanket over her. (7) A white cat appears and sits next to the girl on the sofa. The girl is now relaxed, wrapped in the blanket, while the yellow character sits beside her playing his game. (8) A green checkmark graphic appears at the bottom with bold text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: When she comes home tired. [Subtitle]: 當她很累的回到家. [Logo]: SUBSCRIBE. (2) [Slogan]: Wrong Reaction. [Slogan]: 錯誤反應. (3) [Slogan]: Right Reaction. [Slogan]: 正確反應.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A girl with pink hair in two buns wearing a white t-shirt and pink/white socks; a round yellow character wearing brown shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple indoor living room with a blue sofa, a brown door, and a yellow wall. A pillow on the sofa has a YouTube-style logo and the word 'SUBSCRIBE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, synthesized BGM begins with a clear rhythmic pulse. The sound of a door handle clicking and a door opening is heard. (2) A sharp, breathy female sigh occurs, followed by a soft percussive landing sound. (3) A sudden, loud 'Wrong' buzzer sound effect (low frequency, dissonant) triggers a momentary pause in the BGM. (4) The BGM resumes its cheerful loop. Sound of a door opening again. (5) Rapid 'whoosh' sounds and digital sliding SFX play as movement occurs. (6) A distinct metallic/plastic 'snap' or 'click' sound is heard. (7) Liquid pouring sounds and a 'slurp' sound effect follow. (8) A soft fabric rustling sound occurs. (9) A high-pitched 'Ding' or chime SFX rings out, indicating a positive conclusion, as the music reaches a final chord.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the ideal way a partner should support their significant other when they return home exhausted. It contrasts an indifferent reaction with an exaggeratedly attentive and caring one, emphasizing comfort, snacks, and the relief of removing restrictive clothing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A classic 2D animation style common in short-form social media content, focusing on relatable relationship dynamics.
